description: This file defines a custom exception class 'UserNotFoundException' used for handling cases where a user is not found in the identity infrastructure of the web application.

classes.name: UserNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception class that inherits from System.Exception, used to indicate a user was not found based on a username.

methods.name: UserNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message indicating the username for which no user was found.
